## Meddelande 178 — Johnny (användare)

ge mig prompten till claude för detta

---

## Meddelande 179 — ChatGPT (assistent)

Ja — skicka detta som **nästa tillägg i samma Claude Code Plan Mode-session**. Det ska göra cross-model evaluation och workforce evolution till en förstaklassdel av Web Gym, inte ett sidospår.

```text
Add the following as a FIRST-CLASS requirement to the Universal Web Competency
and Web Gym architecture.

Do not implement yet.

This extends the previously defined:

- Web Body of Knowledge
- Curriculum Compiler
- Web Gym
- Synthetic Practice Bank
- Benchmark Bank
- Hidden Holdouts
- Experience Layer
- Competency Evolution
- Knowledge Radar
- Experiment System

with a provider-neutral CROSS-MODEL WORKFORCE EVOLUTION system.

======================================================================
CORE IDEA
======================================================================

Nortropic must not become:

"Claude learns to build websites."

The target is:

"Nortropic learns which combination of models, roles, curricula, tools,
contexts and workflows produces the strongest professional web organization."

Different model families should be usable as:

- candidate workers
- candidate reviewers
- candidate judges
- challengers
- critics
- researchers
- builders
- strategists

For example:

Claude may build.
An OpenAI model may review.

An OpenAI model may strategize.
Claude may adversarially critique it.

Both may independently judge anonymized competing outputs.

Future providers/models must be able to enter the same system without
redesigning Webbförvaltningen.

The architecture should therefore be PROVIDER-NEUTRAL.

======================================================================
1. MODEL ≠ ROLE ≠ COMPETENCY
======================================================================

Explicitly separate:

MODEL
ROLE
WORKER CONFIGURATION
COMPETENCY
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

A model is merely one component of a worker.

Conceptually:

WORKER CONFIGURATION
=
model/provider
+
role
+
system/role instructions
+
curriculum
+
tools
+
context/retrieval policy
+
capability knowledge
+
relevant professional experience
+
workflow constraints

Do not define professional competency as:

"uses the strongest/latest model."

A newer model is not automatically a better:

- Website Strategist
- Visual Designer
- Builder
- UX Reviewer
- Accessibility Reviewer
- Content Strategist
- Security Reviewer
- Researcher

Competency must be demonstrated.

======================================================================
2. NEW MODEL = CANDIDATE EMPLOYEE
======================================================================

When a new Claude/OpenAI/Google/open-source/future model appears,
do NOT globally replace the existing workforce.

Treat it as a:

CANDIDATE EMPLOYEE

Evaluate it against incumbent workers.

A new model may be:

excellent at visual strategy
but weaker at security review;

excellent at code
but weaker at content;

excellent at adversarial UX
but expensive or inconsistent.

Allow role-specific promotion.

Example:

NEW MODEL

Website Strategy       BETTER
Accessibility Review   BETTER
Visual Craft           SAME
Content Strategy       WORSE
Security Review        WORSE

RESULT

PROMOTE:
Website Strategist
Accessibility Reviewer

KEEP INCUMBENT:
Content Strategist
Security Reviewer

There should be no concept of a mandatory global model upgrade.

======================================================================
3. WORKFORCE EVOLUTION
======================================================================

Web Gym should be capable of evaluating not only individual models but
complete workforce compositions.

Example candidate teams:

TEAM A

Claude Strategist
Claude Builder
OpenAI Code Reviewer
Claude Visual Reviewer

TEAM B

OpenAI Strategist
Claude Builder
OpenAI Reviewer
OpenAI Visual Critic

TEAM C

OpenAI Strategist
OpenAI Builder
Claude Reviewer
Claude Visual Critic

Evaluate complete organizations against:

- quality
- factual correctness
- user-task success
- regressions
- hidden holdout performance
- professional-standard compliance
- capability-specific performance
- reviewer disagreement
- cost
- latency
- reliability

The optimization target is:

BEST VERIFIED ORGANIZATION

not:

BEST SINGLE MODEL.

======================================================================
4. CROSS-MODEL REVIEW
======================================================================

Where model-based judgment is appropriate, prefer independent review across
different model families when economically and technically justified.

Examples:

Claude-produced website strategy
→ OpenAI adversarial reviewer

OpenAI-produced quality contract
→ Claude reviewer

Claude-built website
→ OpenAI UX critic

OpenAI-built website
→ Claude visual critic

This is intended to reduce correlated self-confirmation.

However:

CROSS-MODEL AGREEMENT
≠
OBJECTIVE TRUTH.

Two different providers can share the same bias.

Mechanical/empirical evidence remains stronger wherever available.

======================================================================
5. BLIND EVALUATION
======================================================================

Model-based judges should not know which provider/model produced an artifact
unless identity is specifically required for the evaluation.

Prefer:

CANDIDATE A
CANDIDATE B

rather than:

CLAUDE OUTPUT
OPENAI OUTPUT.

Prevent:

- brand preference
- provider loyalty
- model-family preference
- reputation bias

from influencing judging.

Where possible, normalize irrelevant metadata before evaluation.

======================================================================
6. RECIPROCAL JUDGING
======================================================================

Design a reciprocal cross-model judging mechanism.

Example:

Claude creates Strategy A.
OpenAI creates Strategy B.

Both outputs are anonymized.

Then:

Claude Judge evaluates A/B.
OpenAI Judge evaluates A/B.

Potential matrix:

                  CLAUDE JUDGE     OPENAI JUDGE

Candidate A             x                y
Candidate B             x                y

Analyze:

- agreement
- disagreement
- systematic strictness
- provider preference
- rubric-specific differences
- consistency across repeated trials.

Do not simply average all judge scores.

======================================================================
7. MODEL DISAGREEMENT IS EVIDENCE
======================================================================

If judges materially disagree:

DO NOT silently collapse:

EXCELLENT + WEAK
→ GOOD.

Instead create:

JUDGE_DISAGREEMENT

and investigate.

Potential responses:

- inspect rubric
- obtain another independent judge
- use deterministic evidence
- run synthetic-user evaluation
- inspect relevant professional source
- request occasional human calibration
- accept that the criterion is inherently subjective

Disagreement itself may reveal:

- bad rubric
- ambiguous quality definition
- judge bias
- genuinely subjective design judgment
- missing project context.

======================================================================
8. RUBRIC DECOMPOSITION
======================================================================

Avoid asking one model:

"Is this a good website?"

Decompose evaluation by professional dimension.

Examples:

- business/user clarity
- top-task success
- information architecture
- factual truth
- trust
- visual hierarchy
- typography/craft
- accessibility
- content
- mobile usability
- performance
- search/discoverability
- project-specific outcomes

Different graders may be best for different dimensions.

Use mechanical graders wherever possible.

Use model-based graders only where semantic or qualitative judgment is
actually required.

======================================================================
9. GRADER HIERARCHY
======================================================================

Design an evidence hierarchy.

Conceptually:

DETERMINISTIC / MECHANICAL EVIDENCE
>
OBSERVED BROWSER / SYSTEM OUTCOME
>
PROTECTED SYNTHETIC USER OUTCOME
>
CALIBRATED MODEL JUDGE
>
UNCALIBRATED MODEL OPINION

Examples:

Broken link
→ machine.

Checkout failed
→ browser/outcome.

User cannot find required information
→ synthetic user/eval.

Visual distinctiveness
→ calibrated qualitative reviewer.

Do not use an LLM judge for something a deterministic test can prove.

======================================================================
10. JUDGES MUST THEMSELVES BE EVALUATED
======================================================================

A frontier model is not automatically a reliable evaluator.

Build a JUDGE COMPETENCY concept.

A judge should be evaluated against:

- expert/human calibration samples
- known good/bad cases
- hidden benchmark cases
- repeatability
- cross-judge agreement
- false positives
- false negatives
- provider/self preference
- severity calibration

A judge may be strong at:

clarity
information architecture

but weak at:

visual taste.

Track domain-specific judge competence.

Do not promote an evaluator merely because it is a stronger general model.

======================================================================
11. SELF-PREFERENCE / SAME-FAMILY BIAS
======================================================================

Treat same-model or same-family self-evaluation as a risk.

Do not assume:

Claude reviewing Claude
or
OpenAI reviewing OpenAI

is independent evidence.

Same-family review may still be useful.

But where the quality dimension is subjective or vulnerable to stylistic
preference, prefer at least one independent family or other evidence source.

Explicitly research current evidence regarding:

- self-preference bias
- judge bias
- pairwise judging
- reciprocal judging
- multi-judge systems
- evaluator calibration

and incorporate only what is adequately supported.

======================================================================
12. HUMAN CALIBRATION
======================================================================

Do not design Web Gym around constant human review.

The goal remains autonomous professional development.

But preserve a small human calibration mechanism for subjective evaluators.

For example, occasionally sample:

- visual evaluations
- UX judgments
- content/taste decisions

and compare:

Claude judge
OpenAI judge
human expert/owner/qualified reviewer

Use those samples to detect evaluator drift.

Do not require the owner to inspect every gym session.

Human calibration should be exception/sampling based, not the daily control
loop.

======================================================================
13. WEB GYM CHALLENGER GENERATION
======================================================================

When Web Gym identifies a competency weakness, allow it to generate multiple
challenger configurations.

A challenger may vary:

MODEL
ROLE PROMPT
CURRICULUM
KNOWLEDGE RETRIEVAL
EXAMPLES
TOOLS
CONTEXT POLICY
WORKFLOW
REVIEW STRUCTURE
MODEL ROUTING

Example:

INCUMBENT

Claude
+ Strategy Prompt v7
+ Curriculum v12

CHALLENGER A

OpenAI
+ same curriculum

CHALLENGER B

Claude
+ new strategy curriculum

CHALLENGER C

OpenAI
+ new curriculum

This allows Nortropic to determine WHY performance changed.

Do not change ten variables simultaneously unless intentionally testing a
whole-team composition.

======================================================================
14. WEB GYM TRAINING LOOP
======================================================================

The owner should eventually be able to issue a simple bounded command:

"Start Web Gym."

After that the system should autonomously:

1. freeze current incumbent workforce;
2. inspect competency health;
3. select highest-value weaknesses;
4. choose/generate curriculum;
5. spawn challengers;
6. run practice trials;
7. cluster failures;
8. generate improvement hypotheses;
9. run benchmarks;
10. run protected hidden holdouts;
11. perform cross-model/independent review;
12. check regressions;
13. compare cost/latency/reliability;
14. reject overfit challengers;
15. promote only evidence-backed improvements through the normal trust path;
16. establish the new incumbent;
17. produce a concise management report.

The owner should NOT have to:

- manually choose every exercise
- inspect every trajectory
- rewrite prompts
- choose which model wins
- manually compare outputs.

======================================================================
15. PRACTICE / BENCHMARK / HIDDEN HOLDOUT SEPARATION
======================================================================

Preserve strong separation:

PRACTICE BANK

May be inspected.
May guide improvements.
May be dynamically generated.

BENCHMARK BANK

Stable recurring comparison suite.
Do not directly optimize against individual answers.

HIDDEN HOLDOUT BANK

Protected from the optimizer/student.
Used for promotion/generalization judgment.

PRODUCTION EXPERIENCE

Real customers.
Separate evidence class.

Never claim:

synthetic success
=
real production success.

Synthetic tests show:

CAN WE SOLVE THIS?

Production shows:

DID IT ACTUALLY WORK?

======================================================================
16. CROSS-MODEL HOLDOUT PROTECTION
======================================================================

No worker being optimized should have access to protected holdout answers or
judge internals.

Do not allow:

student
=
test author
=
holdout curator
=
final judge

under one unrestricted context.

Use role/context separation.

Existing Nortropic trust principles should govern this.

======================================================================
17. MODEL-SPECIFIC CONTAMINATION
======================================================================

Investigate the risk that a benchmark or synthetic case may already be known
to a model from public training data.

Design against misleading competence results.

Possible mitigations:

- private/generated cases
- mutation
- hidden held-out combinations
- dynamically generated business constraints
- novel contradiction patterns
- private rubric details
- multiple trials

Do not rely solely on famous public benchmarks for professional competency.

======================================================================
18. SYNTHETIC COMPANY GENERATOR + MULTI-MODEL SPARRING
======================================================================

Integrate this with the previously proposed Synthetic Company Generator.

The generator should be capable of producing diverse company/problem
combinations from dimensions such as:

- organization type
- user groups
- business model
- geography
- languages
- capabilities
- content availability
- brand constraints
- integrations
- regulation
- ambiguity
- contradictory evidence
- stakeholder conflicts
- technical legacy
- accessibility requirements
- unusual success criteria

Then different workers can solve the SAME case.

This allows:

CLAUDE STRATEGIST
vs
OPENAI STRATEGIST

or future model families.

The point is not competition for entertainment.

The point is professional comparison and learning.

======================================================================
19. FAILURE-DRIVEN TRAINING
======================================================================

When multiple trials fail:

do not merely count FAIL.

Cluster failure modes.

Example:

20 trials

6 failures:

3:
misunderstood organizational outcome

2:
incorrect capability composition

1:
weak visual hierarchy

Then create targeted training objectives:

OUTCOME DISCOVERY UNDER AMBIGUITY
CAPABILITY COMPOSITION
VISUAL PRIORITY

Generate new practice cases testing the underlying concept rather than
memorizing the original case.

======================================================================
20. PRODUCTION FAILURE → SANITIZED GYM CASE
======================================================================

Real customer failures should be able to improve Web Gym without turning
customer data into training fixtures.

Example:

REAL CUSTOMER FAILURE

Users could not determine geographic eligibility before submitting a form.

Extract:

GENERAL FAILURE PATTERN

"User needs eligibility information before committing to primary action."

Then generate several fictional cases:

electrician
clinic
delivery service
etc.

Test the generalized weakness.

Keep:

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE
separate from
SYNTHETIC TRAINING.

Preserve privacy/confidentiality boundaries.

======================================================================
21. PROMOTION RULE
======================================================================

No challenger should replace an incumbent solely because:

- one model judge preferred it;
- average subjective score increased;
- it is a newer model;
- it performs better on practice data;
- it won one synthetic case.

Promotion should require, appropriate to the role:

- relevant benchmark improvement
- protected holdout generalization
- no unacceptable regression
- independent/cross-model review
- mechanical compliance
- stable repeated trials
- acceptable cost/latency
- competence-specific evidence.

Promotion remains a Nortropic trust transition.

Web Gym may propose and execute bounded improvement workflows under existing
authority.

Web Gym may NOT weaken its own success criteria merely to produce a winner.

======================================================================
22. STUDENT CANNOT MOVE THE GOALPOSTS
======================================================================

This is a HARD principle.

If a challenger fails:

security
accessibility
professional standard
hidden holdout
quality contract

the training process cannot simply change the evaluator until it passes.

Separate mutable surfaces.

Lower-risk experimental surfaces may include:

- worker prompts
- curriculum selection
- retrieval
- examples
- model choice
- role routing
- workflow sequencing

Higher-authority surfaces include:

- Website Standard
- hard-gate semantics
- grader authority
- holdout definitions
- security requirements
- accessibility requirements
- knowledge-authority hierarchy
- promotion policy

Changes to those require the appropriate separate author/reviewer/trust path.

======================================================================
23. COST / LATENCY / QUALITY FRONTIER
======================================================================

The best professional workforce is not necessarily:

maximum model everywhere.

Evaluate:

QUALITY
COST
LATENCY
RELIABILITY

Example:

A cheaper/faster model may perform indistinguishably from the frontier model
for deterministic content extraction.

A frontier model may be materially better for:

complex strategy
visual reasoning
adversarial architecture review.

Allow routing by task complexity and demonstrated competency.

Do not sacrifice material quality merely to reduce token cost.

But avoid using expensive frontier models where evidence shows no benefit.

======================================================================
24. DIVERSITY AS A SYSTEM PROPERTY
======================================================================

Investigate whether model-family diversity materially improves quality or
merely increases cost.

Do not assume diversity is automatically useful.

Measure:

- unique defects found
- correlated misses
- false positives
- disagreement quality
- final holdout improvement
- incremental cost.

Potential conclusion may be:

cross-family review valuable for strategy/design;

same-model plus deterministic gates sufficient for simpler tasks.

Let evidence decide.

======================================================================
25. PROVIDER NEUTRALITY
======================================================================

The architecture must not encode:

Claude = builder
OpenAI = reviewer

as permanent truth.

Use conceptual interfaces such as:

MODEL_PROVIDER
MODEL_ID
WORKER_CONFIGURATION
ROLE
COMPETENCY_PROFILE

Provider-specific adapters may exist.

Professional logic must remain provider-neutral.

Future models should be onboardable as challenger employees without rewriting
the competency architecture.

======================================================================
26. MODEL ROUTING
======================================================================

Design a future Workforce Router capable of selecting workers based on:

- role
- proven competency
- project capabilities
- risk
- task complexity
- current model availability
- context requirement
- cost
- latency
- prior performance

Example:

simple metadata extraction
→ smaller worker

complex unfamiliar organization strategy
→ frontier strategist

security-sensitive review
→ strongest proven security reviewer

visual craft
→ strongest proven visual worker

Do not implement dynamic routing before sufficient eval evidence exists.

But make the architecture compatible with it.

======================================================================
27. WEB GYM MANAGEMENT REPORT
======================================================================

At the end of an autonomous gym session, the owner should receive managerial
information, not raw trajectories.

Example:

WEB GYM COMPLETED

Focus:
Complex organization strategy

Practice cases:
84

Incumbent:
Claude / Strategy v7

Challengers:
OpenAI configuration
Claude curriculum challenger

Outcome:
Challenger B promoted

Hidden holdout:
Improved

Regressions:
None detected

Cost:
acceptable

New weaknesses discovered:
2

Next recommended focus:
Information architecture

Nothing needs owner attention.

Exact technical evidence remains available below the executive layer.

======================================================================
28. GYM MODES
======================================================================

Design the architecture so future owner intent can be as simple as:

GYM
→ improve highest-value weakness automatically

or targeted:

GYM: Visual Craft
GYM: Accessibility
GYM: Unknown Domains
GYM: B2B
GYM: Frontier
GYM: Evaluate New Model
GYM: Adversarial Robustness
GYM: Prepare Commerce Competency

Do not require these UI/commands immediately.

But make the underlying training architecture compatible.

Default behavior should eventually be:

"Improve the organization where current evidence suggests the greatest
professional return."

======================================================================
29. RESEARCH REQUIREMENT
======================================================================

Before finalizing this architecture, research current evidence and practice
around:

- LLM-as-judge
- pairwise evaluation
- reciprocal judging
- self-preference bias
- evaluator bias
- rubric decomposition
- multi-judge consensus
- judge calibration
- hidden holdouts
- benchmark contamination
- agent evaluation
- repeated stochastic trials
- failure trajectory learning
- model routing
- mixture-of-agents / heterogeneous agent teams where relevant
- evaluator overfitting
- self-improving agent systems

Prioritize:

- OpenAI primary sources
- Anthropic primary sources
- strong papers
- reproducible open-source work

Separate:

ESTABLISHED EVIDENCE
from
PROMISING FRONTIER RESEARCH
from
OUR DESIGN HYPOTHESIS.

Do not oversell research conclusions.

======================================================================
30. RED TEAM CROSS-MODEL EVOLUTION
======================================================================

Actively try to break this design.

Look for:

- Claude and OpenAI sharing the same bias
- same-source web knowledge causing correlated mistakes
- judges preferring their own model family
- judges preferring familiar writing style
- evaluation collusion through shared context
- benchmark leakage
- hidden holdout accidentally becoming visible
- judge drift
- reward hacking
- student modifying grader
- model arms race increasing cost without quality
- evaluator committees averaging away useful disagreement
- fake objectivity in visual design
- excessive number of model calls
- provider outage/dependency
- unstable model versions
- new model regressions
- optimized synthetic performance but poor production outcomes
- curriculum overfitting
- synthetic-company generator producing unrealistic businesses
- one provider dominating every role simply because benchmark design favors its style.

For each proposed mechanism answer:

WHAT SPECIFIC FAILURE DOES THIS PREVENT?

HOW WILL WE KNOW IT HELPS?

WHAT IS ITS COST?

WHEN SHOULD WE NOT USE IT?

======================================================================

Add explicit sections to the Universal Web Competency/Web Gym plan for:

B. WORKER CONFIGURATION MODEL

C. MODEL/ROLE/COMPETENCY SEPARATION

D. CANDIDATE EMPLOYEE ONBOARDING

E. CROSS-MODEL REVIEW

F. BLIND / RECIPROCAL JUDGING

G. JUDGE COMPETENCY + CALIBRATION

H. SELF-PREFERENCE BIAS MITIGATION

I. DISAGREEMENT HANDLING

J. GRADER EVIDENCE HIERARCHY

K. PRACTICE/BENCHMARK/HOLDOUT ISOLATION

L. SYNTHETIC COMPANY SPARRING

M. FAILURE-DRIVEN TRAINING

N. PRODUCTION-FAILURE → SANITIZED-GYM-CASE PIPELINE

O. WORKFORCE CHALLENGER GENERATION

P. PROMOTION / REGRESSION POLICY

Q. COST/LATENCY/QUALITY ROUTING

R. PROVIDER-NEUTRAL ADAPTER MODEL

S. NEW-MODEL EVALUATION WORKFLOW

T. WEB GYM AUTONOMY

U. OWNER MANAGEMENT REPORT

V. CROSS-MODEL RED-TEAM FINDINGS

W. WHAT NOT TO BUILD YET

X. SMALLEST USEFUL CROSS-MODEL EXPERIMENT

======================================================================
32. SMALLEST USEFUL EXPERIMENT
======================================================================

Unless repository evidence suggests a better experiment, consider something
close to:

- select 5-10 carefully designed fictional companies;
- include materially different organization types;
- create a protected quality rubric;
- have one Claude strategist and one OpenAI strategist independently produce
  strategy / capability plan / Site Quality Contract;
- anonymize outputs;
- have Claude and OpenAI independently perform decomposed reciprocal review;
- add deterministic graders wherever possible;
- compare disagreement;
- use a small human calibration sample;
- keep at least some cases hidden from the workers;
- determine whether cross-model diversity finds genuinely unique defects and
  improves final quality enough to justify the complexity/cost.

Do NOT assume the experiment will prove cross-model is better.

A valid result is:

"The additional model family adds cost but no meaningful signal."

Evidence should decide whether this architecture is broadly used or reserved
for specific high-value roles.

======================================================================
ULTIMATE REQUIREMENT
======================================================================

Add the following long-term property:

GYM_AUTONOMY

Given a bounded owner command to begin a Web Gym session, Nortropic should
eventually be capable of autonomously:

- diagnosing professional competency weaknesses;
- selecting/generating appropriate curriculum;
- spawning challenger worker configurations across available model families;
- training/evaluating those challengers;
- using protected benchmarks and hidden holdouts;
- applying deterministic, cross-model and calibrated qualitative graders as
  appropriate;
- detecting disagreement, regressions and overfitting;
- comparing quality/cost/latency;
- promoting only evidence-backed improvements through the normal Nortropic
  trust machinery;
- establishing the improved workforce as the new incumbent;
- producing a concise management report;

without requiring the owner to manually:

- choose exercises;
- inspect all trajectories;
- rewrite prompts;
- decide which model is better;
- choose the winning worker configuration.

The system must NEVER interpret self-improvement authority as permission to
lower standards, reveal holdouts, weaken security, alter fundamental trust
semantics or move its own goalposts.

The desired outcome is not:

"Claude becomes better at websites."

It is:

"Nortropic becomes progressively better at assembling and evolving the best
available professional web organization from Claude, OpenAI and future model
families, grounded in theory, standards, real experience, protected
evaluation and production evidence."

Do not implement yet.

Research, inspect the repository, falsify the idea and integrate the strongest
evidence-backed version into the existing Universal Web Competency / Web Gym
implementation plan.
```

Det viktigaste här är sista distinktionen:

> **Vi tränar inte en modell. Vi tränar organisationen.**

Om Claude är bäst på design och OpenAI bäst på adversarial review just då använder Nortropic det. När nästa modellgeneration kommer får den göra ett “anställningsprov” i Gymmet. Om den är bättre inom en viss yrkesroll får den rollen — inte automatiskt hela fabriken.

Det här gör även Web Gym betydligt mer framtidssäkert: **modellerna blir utbytbara arbetskraftskomponenter medan Nortropics yrkeskunskap, erfarenhet, evals och kvalitetsstandarder består och fortsätter växa.** memcite

Jag skulle ändra mental modell från:

```text
GitHub
→ hittar cool skill
→ installerar
→ alla agents använder den
```

till:

```text
OPEN SOURCE
     ↓
SPECIALKOMPETENS-RADAR
     ↓
KANDIDAT
     ↓
provenance / license / security

semantic overlap analysis
     ↓
WEB GYM

     ↓
MARGINAL CONTRIBUTION

     ↓
Curriculum Compiler
     ↓
endast rätt worker + rätt projekt
```

Precis som med modeller:

> **Ny skill = kandidatmedarbetare, inte automatisk anställning.**

# Marginalnytta är nyckeln

Anta att vi redan har:

```text
frontend-design
impeccable
taste
emil-design-eng
```

och hittar:

```text
better-ui
```

Det är helt ointressant att `better-ui` får 93/100 ensam.

Frågan är:

> **Blir Nortropic bättre när vi lägger till den ovanpå det vi redan har?**

Vi ska därför köra:

```text
BASELINE
Current Specialkompetens Set
        ↓
Web Gym

CHALLENGER
Current Set + Candidate
        ↓
samma gym

COMPARE

unique defects caught
visual quality
task success
false positives
context tokens
latency
cost
holdout generalization
```

Om:

```text
quality +0
context +18%
latency +12%
```

→ **REJECT.**

Om:

```text
animation defects -42%
holdout +9%
context +2%
```

→ **PROMOTE for MOTION_REVIEW only.**

Det här blir Harness Ablation fast för yrkeskompetens.

# Vi behöver även kunna ta **delar** av en skill

Det du säger om “fulla skills eller delar” är viktigt.

Vår atom bör inte nödvändigtvis vara:

```text
GitHub repo
```

eller ens:

```text
SKILL.md
```

Vi bör kunna klassificera:

```text
FULL_SKILL

REFERENCE_PACK
ex. typografi

RULE_PACK
ex. 40 accessibility rules

DETECTOR
ex. AI-slop scanner

PROCEDURE
ex. animation review sequence

TOOL_ADAPTER
ex. Chrome DevTools performance audit

EXAMPLE_CORPUS

DECISION_FRAMEWORK
ex. when to animate

KNOWLEDGE_FRAGMENT
```

Så kanske Impeccable som **hel kompetens** överlappar för mycket med vår designkanon.

Men dess deterministic detectors är extremt värdefulla.

Då kan resultatet bli:

```text
IMPECCABLE FULL
REJECT / unnecessary overlap

IMPECCABLE DETECTORS
CERTIFIED
```

Det är mycket mer sofistikerat.

# Statusarna kan vara

```text
DISCOVERED
      ↓
TRIAGED
      ↓
CANDIDATE
      ↓
GYM_VALIDATED
      ↓
CERTIFIED
      ↓
INCUMBENT
```

och åt andra hållet:

```text
CHALLENGED
STALE
SUPERSEDED
RETIRED
REJECTED
```

---

# Radarn bör också kontrollera säkerhet

Det här är viktigt eftersom en `SKILL.md` inte bara är kunskap.

Den kan innehålla:

```text
Bash
scripts
downloads
network calls
MCP
hooks
package installs
```

Så discovery måste göra:

```text
PROVENANCE
LICENSE
TOOLS
SCRIPTS
NETWORK
SIDE EFFECTS
DEPENDENCIES
MUTABLE REMOTE INPUTS
PROMPT INJECTION SURFACE
```

innan den ens får komma till Gymmet.

Och här har vi redan ett riktigt exempel.

Er Vercel `web-design-guidelines` säger:

> hämta senaste `command.md` från `main` när den körs. fileciteturn52file0L2-L2

Det är perfekt ur **freshness-perspektiv** men inte perfekt ur **Nortropic trust-perspektiv**.

Jag skulle istället göra:

```text
RADAR
detect upstream change
↓
download candidate
↓
diff
↓
review
↓
gym regression
↓
pin exact commit/hash
↓
promote
```

Inte:

```text
production agent
→ blindly execute whatever is on upstream main today
```

Det är exakt där våra två världar möts:

> **ständigt aktuell, men aldrig muterbar utan review.**

# Radarn ska leta efter gaps, inte bara nya repos

Exempel:

```text
CURRENT SPECIALKOMPETENS

Visual Design          strong
Motion                 medium
Typography             medium
Accessibility          shallow
Web Performance        shallow
React/Next Architecture ?
SEO                     ?
Content authenticity   medium
Commerce UX             missing
```

Radarn söker då först:

```text
ACCESSIBILITY
PERFORMANCE
```

inte:

> “Top trending Claude skills”.

Det blir **competency-driven discovery**.

---

# Och Web Gym blir examinationen

Säg att AccessLint upptäcks.

```text
CURRENT ACCESSIBILITY REVIEWER
vs
CURRENT + ACCESSLINT
```

Vi kör:

- known accessibility defects
- keyboard cases
- screen-reader-related cases
- hidden WCAG cases
- deliberately misleading cases
- false-positive cases

Sedan kanske vi lär oss:

```text
AccessLint:
+31% unique defects
+2% false positives

PROMOTE
```

Eller:

```text
UI-UX-Pro-Max accessibility fragment:
+1% unique defects
+15% noise

DO NOT USE FOR ACCESSIBILITY
```

Nu bygger vi **kompetensprofiler för specialkompetenserna själva**.

---

# Det blir ännu bättre tillsammans med modellerna

Kompetensen behöver inte fungera lika bra på alla modeller.

Vi kan mäta:

```text
                     CLAUDE    OPENAI

Emil Motion             ++       +
Impeccable              ++       ++
AccessLint              +++      +++
Vercel React            ++       +++
Taste                    +        ++
```

Då kan Curriculum Compiler säga:

> För OpenAI Builder används X.

> För Claude Visual Reviewer används Y.

Skills blir inte längre globala extensions.

De blir **professionell ammunition som routas efter verifierad effekt**.

---

# Jag skulle även lägga in automatisk upstream-bevakning

Exempel:

```text
emilkowalski/skills
current SHA A
        ↓
RADAR detects SHA B
        ↓
DIFF

new:
review-animations rule
pick-ui-library changes
new skill

        ↓
CLASSIFY

MATERIAL / NON-MATERIAL
        ↓
if material:
Web Gym delta suite
        ↓
BETTER?
YES → promote
NO → remain pinned at A
```

Det här betyder att:

> **“latest” ≠ “installed”.**

Latest är kandidat.

Best verified är production.

```text
It is not professional authority.

4. INITIAL EXTERNAL CANDIDATE SCOUT
======================================================================

Research the current open-source ecosystem.

At minimum evaluate the relevance of current sources such as:

- anthropics/claude-plugins-official frontend-design
- emilkowalski/skills
- vercel-labs/agent-skills
- vercel-labs/next-skills
- vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines
- addyosmani/web-quality-skills
- AccessLint/skills
- cloudflare/skills where web-performance relevant
- 21st-dev/skill
- high-quality typography/layout/accessibility/design-engineering skills
- other materially strong sources discovered during research

Also inspect challengers such as broad design orchestrators, but classify
them as frontier rather than automatically trustworthy.

Produce a candidate landscape by professional competency:

DESIGN
MOTION
TYPOGRAPHY
COLOR
LAYOUT
ACCESSIBILITY
PERFORMANCE
REACT
NEXT.JS
CONTENT
SEO
TESTING
SECURITY
COMPONENT SOURCING
DESIGN SYSTEMS
etc.

======================================================================
5. PROVENANCE REGISTRY
======================================================================

Every external specialkompetens must have verified provenance before it can
become production-relevant.

Design a minimal registry capable of binding:

- competency id
- source repository
- source path
- exact upstream commit/tag
- author/organization
- license
- local vendored hash
- vendored date
- competency type
- tool permissions
- scripts
- network behavior
- dependency/install behavior
- current consumers
- update status.

Do not allow:

"source unknown"

for a certified production specialkompetens.

Unknown-source material may remain quarantined until resolved.

======================================================================
6. NO MUTABLE REMOTE PRODUCTION INSTRUCTIONS
======================================================================

Explicitly audit skills that fetch instructions from mutable remote branches
at runtime.

Example class:

SKILL.md
→ fetch latest instructions from upstream main
→ execute them immediately.

This is freshness but not controlled authority.

Preferred Nortropic pattern:

RADAR detects upstream change
→ exact candidate bytes/commit
→ provenance
→ diff
→ security review
→ Web Gym regression
→ independent review
→ pinned promotion

Production workers consume exact reviewed competency bytes.

LATEST
must mean
UPDATE CANDIDATE

not
AUTOMATIC PRODUCTION AUTHORITY.

======================================================================
7. SECURITY / SUPPLY-CHAIN TRIAGE
======================================================================

A skill may contain more than knowledge.

Inspect:

- Bash permissions
- scripts
- hooks
- MCP dependencies
- network calls
- package installation
- remote downloads
- arbitrary command execution
- filesystem writes
- credential needs
- external APIs
- mutable remote content.

Classify the execution surface before Gym evaluation.

Knowledge/reference-only candidates should be distinguishable from
tool-executing competencies.

Fail closed on unclear side effects.

======================================================================
8. FULL SKILL VS ATOMIC COMPETENCY
======================================================================

Do NOT make the GitHub repository or entire SKILL.md the smallest
installable professional unit.

Support evaluation of:

FULL_SKILL
REFERENCE_PACK
RULE_PACK
DETECTOR
PROCEDURE
DECISION_FRAMEWORK
TOOL_ADAPTER
CORPUS
KNOWLEDGE_FRAGMENT

Example:

A large frontend-design package may overlap too much as a whole while its
deterministic detector layer may provide unique value.

Allow:

FULL PACKAGE = REJECTED
DETECTOR COMPONENT = CERTIFIED

when evidence supports that decision.

Respect licenses and attribution when extracting/deriving material.

======================================================================
9. COMPETENCY GAP ANALYSIS
======================================================================

Radar should search based on Nortropic competency gaps, not only trends.

Webbförvaltningen should be able to maintain a map such as:

Visual Design        strong
Motion               strong
Typography           validating
Accessibility        weak
Performance          weak
React                strong
Next.js              validating
SEO                  weak
Commerce UX          unsupported

These labels must eventually come from eval evidence, not subjective claims.

Discovery priority should be influenced by:

gap severity
×
customer relevance
×
risk
×
expected professional value.

======================================================================
10. WEB GYM EVALUATION
======================================================================

Every material candidate specialkompetens must be evaluated in Web Gym
before production promotion.

Compare:

INCUMBENT SPECIALKOMPETENS SET

against:

INCUMBENT + CANDIDATE.

Measure MARGINAL CONTRIBUTION.

Possible evidence:

- unique defects found
- defect severity
- task success
- visual/UX quality
- accessibility performance
- performance results
- false positives
- false negatives
- hidden holdout improvement
- cross-model agreement/disagreement
- context tokens
- latency
- monetary cost
- regressions.

Do NOT ask:

"Is this skill good?"

Ask:

"Does this skill improve Nortropic over the current incumbent system?"

======================================================================
11. SPECIALKOMPETENS ABLATION
======================================================================

More skills are NOT automatically better.

Design periodic ablation.

For a current competency bundle:

A+B+C+D

test:

A+B+C
A+B+D
A+C+D
etc.

Determine whether some competencies are:

- redundant
- contradictory
- stale
- harmful
- context-expensive
- no longer marginally useful.

Optimize toward:

MINIMUM SUFFICIENT HIGH-PERFORMANCE COMPETENCY SET.

The goal is not the largest skills directory.

======================================================================
12. CONFLICT ANALYSIS
======================================================================

Different skills may recommend contradictory professional behavior.

Example:

one design skill:
maximize expressive motion.

another:
motion should be rare.

Do not concatenate both into context and hope.

Detect semantic overlap/conflict.

Resolve through:

- project Quality Contract
- capability
- source authority
- controlled experiment
- role-specific routing
- evidence.

Preserve disagreement if not resolved.

======================================================================
13. ROLE/CAPABILITY-SPECIFIC ROUTING
======================================================================

Certified specialkompetens must not automatically load into every worker.

Curriculum Compiler selects based on:

ROLE
+
PROJECT CAPABILITIES
+
SITE QUALITY CONTRACT
+
MODEL
+
PROVEN COMPETENCY EFFECT
+
CONTEXT BUDGET.

Example:

Visual Reviewer
→ Emil Motion Review
→ Impeccable detector subset
→ relevant Vercel guidelines

Accessibility Specialist
→ AccessLint/WCAG competency
→ project accessibility requirements

Next.js Builder
→ Vercel Next.js/React professional knowledge

Do not keep the current pattern of loading an ever-growing universal
"design canon" into every relevant task unless evidence proves that optimal.

======================================================================
14. MODEL × SPECIALKOMPETENS INTERACTION
======================================================================

Integrate with Cross-Model Workforce Evolution.

A specialkompetens may have different marginal effect depending on model.

Measure:

SPECIALKOMPETENS
×
MODEL
×
ROLE.

Do not assume a competency validated on Claude performs equally on OpenAI
or future models.

Allow model-specific curriculum routing when justified.

======================================================================
15. SPECIALKOMPETENS PROMOTION STATES
======================================================================

Design lifecycle states such as:

DISCOVERED
TRIAGED
CANDIDATE
GYM_VALIDATED
CERTIFIED
INCUMBENT
CHALLENGED
STALE
SUPERSEDED
RETIRED
REJECTED

Use a better taxonomy if justified.

Certified means:

verified useful under a defined scope.

It does NOT mean universally loaded.

======================================================================
16. UPDATE RADAR
======================================================================

For every certified upstream competency:

pin exact current source identity.

Monitor upstream.

When upstream changes:

CURRENT SHA
→ NEW SHA
→ DIFF
→ MATERIALITY
→ if material:
   candidate update
   → delta eval
   → regression
   → promotion/rejection.

Do not auto-update merely because upstream has a new release.

A newer version may regress Nortropic.

======================================================================
17. EXPERT / SOURCE WATCHLIST
======================================================================

Treat strong practitioners and organizations as specialkompetens sources.

Examples:

Emil Kowalski
Vercel design/engineering
Anthropic
Addy Osmani
specialist accessibility organizations
relevant browser/platform teams

This connects Specialkompetens Radar to the broader Web Knowledge Radar.

A new repository/skill published by a watched expert becomes:

DISCOVERED

not:

INSTALLED.

======================================================================
18. PRODUCTION EXPERIENCE CAN CHALLENGE EXTERNAL SKILLS
======================================================================

If a certified external specialkompetens repeatedly produces findings that
do not correlate with real quality or production outcomes:

challenge it.

Example:

External UX skill repeatedly flags pattern X.

Nortropic production evidence consistently shows X is appropriate under a
specific capability/context.

Do not blindly obey external expertise forever.

Create:

CONFLICT
→ experiment
→ scoped finding
→ update routing / retire competency if justified.

External expertise and Nortropic experience should challenge each other.

======================================================================
19. MANAGEMENT VIEW
======================================================================

Future Verkstadsgolvet should be able to represent this at executive level
without listing hundreds of SKILL.md files.

Example:

SPECIALKOMPETENS

Active certified competencies: 17

Updates waiting: 3
New candidates: 5
Stale: 1
Conflicts: 0

Material candidate:
Emil — Animation Review
Gym result: promising

Needs you:
Nothing.

Technical provenance and exact commits remain available at lower depth.

======================================================================
20. FIRST IMPLEMENTATION SHOULD BE SMALL
======================================================================

Do NOT immediately ingest dozens of skills.

The first useful implementation should:

1. inventory and repair provenance of current vendored competencies;
2. map current capability coverage;
3. compare current Nortropic Emil content with official emilkowalski/skills;
4. identify perhaps 3-5 high-value missing candidate competencies;
5. define candidate/provenance representation;
6. create a bounded Web Gym comparison;
7. prove marginal-contribution evaluation;
8. promote at most one candidate as a demonstration;
9. prove an unnecessary candidate can be rejected.

Suggested candidate domains for the first experiment:

- motion review
- accessibility
- web performance
- React/Next.js engineering

Do not make visual design the only form of professional competency.

======================================================================
21. RED TEAM
======================================================================

Attack:

- skills bloat
- context bloat
- GitHub popularity bias
- supply-chain compromise
- license contamination
- prompt injection in upstream skill content
- arbitrary remote execution
- contradictory skills
- stale forks
- unknown provenance
- vendors changing skill semantics
- aesthetic homogenization
- one expert becoming doctrine
- excessive model calls
- skill benchmark overfitting
- evaluator favoring stylistic similarity
- no measurable marginal benefit
- duplicate specialkompetens
- a "skill marketplace" becoming architecture theater.

For each mechanism ask:

What failure does this prevent?
Who consumes it?
How do we measure benefit?
When do we remove it?

22. REQUIRED PLAN ADDITIONS
======================================================================

Add to the Universal Web Competency plan:

F. CANDIDATE REGISTRY

H. ATOMIC COMPETENCY MODEL

K. SPECIALKOMPETENS ABLATION
L. CONFLICT RESOLUTION
M. ROLE/MODEL/CAPABILITY ROUTING
N. PROMOTION / RETIREMENT
O. UPSTREAM UPDATE RADAR
P. MANAGEMENT OBSERVABILITY
Q. WHAT NOT TO INGEST
R. SMALLEST USEFUL FIRST EXPERIMENT

Do not implement yet.

Research the current ecosystem and actual Nortropic repository state,
falsify the concept, and integrate the strongest minimal architecture into
the existing Universal Web Competency / Web Gym plan.
```

### Min första kandidatlista efter researchen

Jag skulle redan nu sätta följande längst upp i Claude-planens **SCOUT**:

1. **Reconcile Emil** mot det officiella `emilkowalski/skills`.
2. **Vercel React + Next.js** som teknisk specialkompetens. citeturn946486search4turn562506search5
3. **AccessLint** som ren accessibility-specialist. citeturn457083search4
4. **Addy Osmani Web Quality** som performance/CWV/SEO challenger. citeturn946486search3
5. **Cloudflare web-perf** som empirisk Chrome/DevTools-baserad performance-specialist. citeturn562506search13
6. **21st.dev** som component-sourcing-specialist, inte som design authority. citeturn310035search0

Och sedan kör vi allt mot det ni redan har istället för att anta att “nytt = bättre”.

Det är här **specialkompetens** blir mycket mer än ett nytt namn på skills: det blir Nortropics mekanism för att **rekrytera världens bästa öppna yrkeskunskap, examinera den själv, kombinera den med rätt modeller och kontinuerligt ersätta sig själv när något bättre dyker upp.** memcite

## Meddelande 188 — Johnny (användare)

täcker detta även mcps och andra tools, verktyg som kan bidra till ökad kvalité? Think hard, brainstorma

---

## Meddelande 189 — ChatGPT (assistent)

Ja — och jag skulle **bredda modellen nu**. “Specialkompetens” bör vara **kunskapen om hur man gör jobbet**, medan MCP:er, CLI:er, browser automation, analyzers, testverktyg, designverktyg och API:er är **yrkesverktygen**. Båda måste kunna upptäckas, provas i Gymmet och certifieras separat.

Jag kollar både vad Nortropic redan använder och vilka verktygskategorier som 2026 faktiskt kan ge mätbar kvalitetsökning, så vi inte bara får en större verktygslåda utan en bättre organisation.

---

## Meddelande 190 — ChatGPT (assistent)

En viktig designregel faller ut direkt från researchen: **MCP ska inte vara målet.** Det är bara ett gränssnitt. Microsofts Playwright-team skriver själva att CLI+skills ofta är bättre för coding agents eftersom det är mer token-effektivt, medan MCP är bättre för långlivade, explorativa browser-loopar. 

Så Nortropic bör välja **bästa instrumentet + bästa integrationsformen** per yrkesuppgift — MCP, CLI, bibliotek/API eller egen adapter — och sedan bevisa marginalnyttan i Web Gym.

---

## Meddelande 191 — ChatGPT (assistent)

Ja — **och jag skulle faktiskt ändra arkitekturen en nivå till**.

Det vi hittills kallat Specialkompetens täcker kunskap, procedurer och vissa tool-adapters, men **MCP:er och andra yrkesverktyg är så viktiga att de bör få ett eget förstaklasslager**.

Jag skulle kalla det:

# **Nortropic Instrumentarium**

Skillnaden blir:

> **Specialkompetens = vad yrkespersonen kan.**  
> **Instrumentarium = vad yrkespersonen kan se, mäta och göra med.**

En kirurg kan vara världens bästa kirurg men behöver fortfarande rätt instrument. Samma sak här.

```text
WEB WORKER

Model
+
Role
+
Specialkompetens
+
Knowledge / Curriculum
+
INSTRUMENTARIUM
+
Experience
+
Authority
=
Professional capability
```

Och ja: **MCP är bara ett sätt att ansluta ett instrument**. Det är inte i sig ett kvalitetsmått.

Microsofts Playwright-team säger själva att CLI + skills ofta är bättre för coding agents eftersom det använder mindre context, medan Playwright MCP passar bättre för långlivade/explorativa browser-loopar. citeturn296742search4turn296742search15

Det är en väldigt viktig princip för Nortropic:

> Vi ska inte fråga “finns det en MCP för det här?”  
> Vi ska fråga **“vilket verktyg och vilket interface ger bäst verifierad yrkeskvalitet?”**

---

# Vi har redan början på detta

Er nuvarande `design-reviewer` har redan `mcp__chrome-devtools` som verktyg och använder riktig browser för viewport-, interaction- och renderad designreview. fileciteturn53file0L1-L2

Det var ett bra val. Chrome DevTools for Agents är nu officiellt stable och har bland annat runtime-debugging, network-inspection och riktiga performance traces. Chrome-teamet beskriver uttryckligen poängen som att coding agents annars programmerar “med ögonbindel” eftersom de inte ser vad koden faktiskt gör i browsern. citeturn904570search0turn904570search3

Men vi kan gå mycket längre.

---

# Jag ser sex sorters yrkesinstrument

| Instrumentklass | Vad den ger Nortropic |
|---|---|
| **Observation** | Se vad sajten faktiskt gör |
| **Interaction** | Agera som användare |
| **Measurement** | Mäta performance, accessibility etc. |
| **Design** | Arbeta med strukturerad design, tokens, komponenter |
| **Verification** | Deterministiskt avgöra om något fungerar |
| **Production evidence** | Se vad som faktiskt händer efter launch |

Det betyder att en Website Strategist, Builder och Reviewer inte nödvändigtvis ska ha samma verktyg.

---

# Chrome DevTools blir nästan “stetoskopet”

Chrome DevTools MCP kan redan ge agenten bland annat:

```text
DOM/runtime
console
network
viewport/emulation
interaction
performance trace
LCP
INP
CLS
request details
browser state
```

citeturn904570search7

Och Google har under 2026 gått ännu längre: DevTools for Agents kan nu ta emot **framework-/app-specifika developer tools** direkt från den körande sidan. Det innebär exempelvis att React eller en framtida Nortropic-runtime kan exponera intern komponent-/state-information direkt till agenten. citeturn904570search1

Det är väldigt relevant för framtiden.

Istället för:

> AI tittar på source och gissar varför UI:t beter sig fel.

kan vi få:

```text
SOURCE
+
RENDERED DOM
+
NETWORK
+
PERFORMANCE TRACE
+
FRAMEWORK STATE
=
much stronger diagnosis
```

---

# Playwright blir “syntetiska användaren”

Här skulle jag sannolikt använda **både Playwright CLI och MCP**, fast för olika jobb.

Playwright kan köra Chromium, Firefox och WebKit och agenten kan navigera via accessibility tree snarare än att gissa koordinater från screenshots. citeturn296742search0turn296742search13

Det passar perfekt för våra:

> Top Task Synthetic Journeys.

Exempel:

```text
CASE

Du är förälder.
Du vill veta om museet är öppet på söndag,
om det går att komma in med rullstol
och vad barnbiljett kostar.

GO.
```

Nortropic observerar:

```text
Task completed?
Wrong navigation?
How many actions?
Missing information?
Ambiguous labels?
Keyboard usable?
```

Det är mycket starkare än en statisk screenshot review.

---

# Accessibility: agenten ska inte “tycka”

Här bör vi kombinera specialkompetens med **deterministiska verktyg**.

Exempel:

### Specialkompetens

```text
WCAG
keyboard patterns
screen reader behavior
inclusive UX
```

### Instrument

```text
axe-core
Playwright
browser accessibility tree
manual/synthetic keyboard journey
```

`axe-core` är open source, används för automatiserad web-accessibility testing och är byggt för integration i functional/acceptance tests. citeturn491879search5turn491879search15

Så:

```text
Accessibility Specialist
        ↓
knows WCAG

axe-core
        ↓
finds deterministically detectable violations

Playwright
        ↓
tests keyboard/user journeys

model reviewer
        ↓
handles semantic issues automation cannot prove
```

Det är en riktig professionell stack.

Inte “Claude tycker sidan verkar accessible”.

---

# Performance får sin egen instrumentlåda

Här finns flera nivåer.

### Lighthouse CI

Kan:

- köras vid varje förändring,
- upptäcka regressions,
- sätta performance budgets,
- köra flera gånger för att minska variance,
- jämföra två versioner. citeturn491879search11

### Chrome DevTools

För root-cause:

```text
why is LCP bad?
which network chain?
which render-blocking resource?
main-thread?
```

### WebPageTest

För mer kontrollerad verklighetslik labbtestning över browsers, locations, connection profiles och flera runs. citeturn412488search0turn412488search5

### Production field data

CrUX/Web Vitals/egen telemetry efter launch.

Då blir:

```text
LIGHTHOUSE
!=
PERFORMANCE TRUTH
```

utan:

```text
CI regression
+
browser trace
+
controlled lab
+
production field evidence
=
performance understanding
```

---

# Figma MCP är mycket mer intressant nu än tidigare

Här tror jag vi bör experimentera.

Figma MCP kan idag:

- läsa komponenter, variables och layout;
- koppla Figma-komponenter till riktig kod via Code Connect;
- generera från design till kod;
- och numera även **skriva tillbaka native Figma frames/components/variables** från agenten. citeturn491879search1turn491879search7

Det öppnar en intressant framtida workflow:

```text
Website Strategist
       ↓
IA / Quality Contract
       ↓
Visual Designer Agent
       ↓
FIGMA
       ↓
Visual Critics
       ↓
refinement
       ↓
approved design intent
       ↓
Builder
       ↓
CODE
       ↓
visual comparison
```

Inte nödvändigt för alla Nortropic-sajter.

Men Web Gym kan testa:

### Current workflow

```text
strategy → code design
```

mot:

### Challenger

```text
strategy → Figma structured design
→ critique
→ code
```

Om Figma-steget faktiskt höjer quality → använd det.

Om det bara gör jobbet långsammare → skippa det.

Det är exakt vår filosofi.

---

# Production-tools blir också kvalitet

Här tror jag vi tidigare varit lite för build-fokuserade.

En bra webbförvaltning behöver kunna se efter deployment:

```text
deploy logs
runtime errors
failed requests
performance
field UX
conversion/outcome
search visibility
```

Vercel har exempelvis nu ett officiellt MCP som kan läsa projekt, deployments och deployment logs. citeturn316403search1

Det skulle kunna ge en Production Reviewer:

```text
Website deployed
      ↓
Vercel deployment evidence
      ↓
browser smoke
      ↓
runtime logs
      ↓
performance
      ↓
verified healthy
```

Men här blir authority mycket känsligare eftersom Vercels MCP även kan hantera projekt/deployments.

Så vår rule bör vara:

```text
READ/OBSERVE tool
≠
WRITE/ACT tool
```

och credentials/scopes måste bindas per roll.

---

# Specialkompetens + Instrument bör kunna paras ihop

Det här är nästan som yrkeslicenser.

Exempel:

```text
SPECIALKOMPETENS:
Performance Engineering

INSTRUMENTS:
Chrome DevTools
Lighthouse CI
WebPageTest

CERTIFIED WORKFLOW:
YES
```

Eller:

```text
SPECIALKOMPETENS:
Visual Craft

INSTRUMENTS:
Figma
Chrome screenshots
visual comparator

CERTIFIED:
VALIDATING
```

Eller:

```text
SPECIALKOMPETENS:
Accessibility

INSTRUMENTS:
axe-core
Playwright
Chrome accessibility tree

CERTIFIED:
YES
```

Så vi kan börja testa **kompetenspaket**, inte bara prompts.

---

# Och Web Gym bör utvärdera verktygen precis som skills/modeller

Det här är den stora konsekvensen.

Säg att vi hittar ett nytt Accessibility MCP.

Vi installerar det inte direkt.

Vi kör:

```text
INCUMBENT

Accessibility specialist
+ axe
+ Playwright


CHALLENGER

Accessibility specialist
+ axe
+ Playwright
+ New MCP
```

På 100 cases.

Resultat:

```text
unique defects       +1
false positives      +37
tool calls           +80
tokens               +25%
latency              +31%
```

→ **REJECT.**

Eller:

```text
unique critical defects +18%
false positives           same
holdout                   +11%
cost                       +3%
```

→ **CERTIFY.**

Samma marginalnytteprincip som Specialkompetens.

---

# Och vi bör göra tool ablation

Det är viktigt.

Efter ett år har vi kanske:

```text
Chrome DevTools
Playwright
axe
Lighthouse
WebPageTest
Figma
visual diff
SEO crawler
...
```

Då frågar Gym:

> Behöver vi verkligen allt?

Test:

```text
FULL TOOLSET
vs
without Lighthouse
vs
without DevTools
vs
without tool X
```

Om tool X inte tillför unika defects/outcomes:

> **RETIRE.**

Vi bygger inte en julgran av integrationer.

---

# MCP har dessutom en betydande säkerhetsdimension

MCP-specifikationen är väldigt tydlig: tools ska behandlas som potentiell **arbitrary code execution**, tool descriptions är inte automatiskt betrodda och data/access kräver tydlig kontroll. citeturn316403search12

Chrome varnar också för att DevTools-agenten kan läsa och agera på allt i en ansluten autentiserad browser. citeturn904570search10

Vercel beskriver samma problem: om man kopplar ihop tools med fel trust-boundary kan prompt injection leda till att en agent för data mellan system den inte borde kombinera. citeturn316403search1

Så varje instrument måste ha:

```text
PROVENANCE
VERSION
PERMISSIONS
NETWORK
FILESYSTEM
SECRETS
WRITE EFFECTS
REMOTE MUTABILITY
DATA ACCESS
AUTHORITY CLASS
```

precis som skills.

---

# Jag skulle därför bredda vår tidigare “Specialkompetens Radar”

Inte ersätta den.

Göra:

# **Professional Capability Radar**

med två huvudgrenar:

```text
              PROFESSIONAL CAPABILITY RADAR
                         │
             ┌───────────┴────────────┐
             ▼                        ▼
      SPECIALKOMPETENS          INSTRUMENTARIUM
             │                        │
     knowledge/procedure          MCP
     rules                       CLI
     heuristics                  library
     decision frameworks         API
     specialist methods          browser tool
                                analyzer
                                test runner
                                design tool
```

Sedan möts de här:

```text
                 WEB GYM
                    │
          marginal contribution
                    │
                    ▼
           CERTIFIED CAPABILITY
```

---

# Jag skulle även lägga in “Tool Interface Competition”

Detta tycker jag är nytt och viktigt.

Samma underlying capability kan finnas som:

```text
Playwright library
Playwright Test
Playwright CLI
Playwright MCP
```

Microsoft säger uttryckligen att MCP och CLI lämpar sig för olika agentworkflows. citeturn296742search2turn296742search15

Så Nortropic bör kunna benchmarka:

```text
PLAYWRIGHT MCP
vs
PLAYWRIGHT CLI
```

på:

```text
task success
tokens
latency
reliability
evidence quality
recovery
```

Kanske blir:

```text
Coding Builder:
Playwright CLI

Synthetic UX Agent:
Playwright MCP

CI:
Playwright Test
```

**Samma verktyg, tre olika interfaces beroende på yrkesroll.**

Det är väldigt professionellt.

---

# Kandidater jag skulle sätta på första Tool Radar

Inte “installera nu”, utan **SCOUT / EVALUATE**:

| Område | Kandidatinstrument | Primär funktion |
|---|---|---|
| Runtime | Chrome DevTools for Agents | browser truth/debug/performance |
| User journeys | Playwright CLI/MCP/Test | synthetic users + E2E |
| Accessibility | axe-core | deterministic a11y |
| Performance CI | Lighthouse CI | regressions/budgets |
| Deep performance | WebPageTest | controlled performance evidence |
| Design | Figma MCP + Code Connect | structured design intent |
| Deployment | Vercel MCP/CLI | deploy/log evidence |
| Browser compatibility | Playwright cross-browser | Chromium/Firefox/WebKit |
| Agentic web | Lighthouse Agentic Browsing | future agent-user quality |

Den sista är särskilt frontier: Google lanserade under 2026 en ny **Lighthouse Agentic Browsing**-kategori för att deterministiskt testa hur väl webbsidor fungerar för AI-agenter som användare. citeturn904570search2

Det passar väldigt väl in i vår framtida Website Standard:

```text
HUMAN-READY
+
AGENT-READY
```

men ska initialt vara `FRONTIER`, inte hard requirement.

---

# Då får vi en riktigt intressant Web Gym

När du säger:

> **“Gym.”**

kan Nortropic inte bara prova:

```text
Claude vs OpenAI
Skill A vs Skill B
```

utan:

```text
Model
×
Specialkompetens
×
Tool
×
Tool interface
×
Curriculum
×
Workflow
```

Exempel:

```text
CHALLENGER 1

Claude
+ Emil Motion
+ Chrome DevTools


CHALLENGER 2

Claude
+ Emil Motion
+ Figma MCP
+ Chrome DevTools


CHALLENGER 3

OpenAI
+ Emil Motion
+ Playwright
+ Chrome DevTools
```

och frågar:

> **Vilken professionell arbetskonfiguration producerar bäst verifierat resultat?**

Det är mycket närmare hur ett företag faktiskt utvecklar produktivitet:

> inte bara genom bättre personal, utan genom bättre personal **med bättre yrkesverktyg och bättre arbetsmetoder**.

---

# Jag skulle därför ändra den stora formeln

Tidigare:

```text
NORTROPIC PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCY

Theory
+ Standards
+ Specialkompetens
+ Models
+ Experience
```

Nu:

```text
NORTROPIC PROFESSIONAL CAPABILITY

THEORY
+
STANDARDS
+
SPECIALKOMPETENS
+
INSTRUMENTARIUM
+
MODEL / WORKER
+
WORKFLOW
+
EXPERIENCE
+
EVALS
```

Och Web Gym optimerar kombinationen.

Det tycker jag är den kompletta modellen.

**Specialkompetens är yrkeskunnandet. Instrumentarium är sinnena och verktygen. Web Gym är utbildning/R&D. Experience är yrkeserfarenheten. Trust Kernel bestämmer vad som faktiskt får bli verklighet.**

Det är mycket starkare än en katalog med Claude skills och MCP-servrar. Det blir en organisation som kontinuerligt kan upptäcka **både bättre kunskap och bättre verktyg**, bevisa att de faktiskt höjer kvaliteten, och sedan sätta rätt kombination i händerna på rätt digital medarbetare. memcite

## Meddelande 193 — ChatGPT (assistent)

Precis. **Det här är kanske en av de största vinsterna med hela riktningen vi just lagt ut.**

Du flyttar arbetet från:

> *“Johnny måste hela tiden upptäcka vad som är nytt, läsa GitHub, följa experter, hitta nya skills, förstå nya MCP:er, avgöra om Claude eller OpenAI blivit bättre och sedan manuellt försöka hålla Nortropic modernt.”*

till:

> **“Nortropic ansvarar för sin egen professionella kompetensutveckling.”**

Det är en fundamental skillnad.

I målbilden blir loopen ungefär:

```text
VÄRLDEN FÖRÄNDRAS
        ↓
Knowledge Radar
Specialkompetens Radar
Instrument Radar
Model Radar
        ↓
nya kandidater upptäcks
        ↓
provenance / security / relevans
        ↓
Web Gym
        ↓
benchmark + holdout + challengers
        ↓
bättre?
   ↙           ↘
 NEJ            JA
ignorera       promovera
                ↓
     Webbförvaltningen uppdateras
                ↓
          riktiga projekt
                ↓
            erfarenhet
                ↓
              Gym
                ↺
```

Och lika viktigt kör vi åt andra hållet också:

```text
gamla regler
gamla skills
gamla tools
gamla modeller
gamla arbetssätt
        ↓
Garbage Collector
        ↓
behövs detta fortfarande?
        ↓
REMOVE / RETIRE / SUPERSEDE
```

Så systemet ska inte bara bli **större** med tiden. Det ska bli **bättre och renare**.

Det förändrar också din relation till omvärldsbevakning. Du behöver inte längre följa varje ny Emil Kowalski-skill, Vercel-release, Claude-plugin, MCP-server eller ny modell för att vara rädd att Nortropic halkar efter. De blir råmaterial till ett systematiskt flöde:

> **upptäck → bedöm → prova → falsifiera → behåll eller kasta.**

Du kan fortfarande komma in och säga:

> “Jag såg något riktigt intressant från X — undersök det.”

Men det blir **bonusinput**, inte en förutsättning för att organisationen ska fortsätta utvecklas.

Och det här är varför jag tycker vårt begrepp **yrkeserfarenhet** är så bra. Efter några år ska Nortropic inte bara vara “uppdaterat med senaste Claude”. Det ska ha något mycket djupare:

```text
professionell teori
+ levande standarder
+ bästa open-source-specialkompetenser
+ bästa verifierade instrument
+ bästa modellmixen
+ tusentals egna erfarenheter
+ misslyckanden
+ experiment
+ produktionsutfall
= ORGANISATORISK YRKESSKICKLIGHET
```

Det där är svårt för en konkurrent att kopiera genom att installera samma modeller.

De kan kopiera Claude.

De kan kopiera en GitHub-skill.

De kan kopiera Playwright.

Men de kan inte direkt kopiera **vad Nortropic har lärt sig om hur alla dessa saker bäst kombineras efter hundratals eller tusentals genomförda arbeten och gympass**.

Det är där jag tror en verklig moat börjar uppstå.

Och ur ditt perspektiv blir den önskvärda slutbilden nästan löjligt enkel:

> **“Gym.”**

eller:

> **“Hur mår Webbförvaltningens kompetens?”**

och Verkstadsgolvet svarar exempelvis:

```text
WEBBFÖRVALTNINGEN

Kompetenshälsa
Healthy

Nya externa kandidater
7 undersökta
2 i gym
5 avvisade

Promoverat sedan sist
1 specialkompetens
1 worker-konfiguration

Pensionerat
2 redundanta regler

Aktiva experiment
3

Behöver dig
Ingenting
```

Det är **precis den typ av abstraktion en chef ska ha**.

Du säger vart organisationen ska utvecklas och hur mycket resurser den får lägga på det. Organisationen sköter själva fortbildningen. memcite

```text
Universal Web Competency / Web Body of Knowledge / Web Gym plan.

======================================================================
MISSION
======================================================================

A major owner goal is to REMOVE the need for continuous manual scouting.

The owner should NOT have to continuously:

- browse GitHub;
- follow every AI/web expert;
- watch every new Agent Skill;
- track every MCP server;
- discover every new CLI/tool;
- notice every framework/platform change;
- compare every Claude/OpenAI release;

- decide which tool is fashionable;
- chase every new "best practice";
- manually keep Nortropic modern.

Instead:

Nortropic Webbförvaltning should become responsible for its own professional
competence development.

The target operating model is:

WORLD CHANGES
      ↓
automatic sensing / discovery
      ↓
candidate knowledge / competence / tools / models
      ↓
triage
      ↓
provenance / security / relevance
      ↓
Web Gym
      ↓
benchmark / holdout / adversarial evaluation
      ↓
verified improvement?
  NO              YES
reject/watch      gated promotion
                    ↓
            better workforce
                    ↓
              real projects
                    ↓
               experience
                    ↓
                  learning
                    ↺

AND independently:

CURRENT KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / TOOLS / MODELS
      ↓
periodic challenge / ablation / garbage collection
      ↓
still useful?
      ↓
KEEP / CHALLENGE / SUPERSEDE / RETIRE / REMOVE

The system must continuously improve without continuously accumulating bloat.

======================================================================
1. TERMINOLOGY: SPECIALKOMPETENS
======================================================================

Use the conceptual term:

SPECIALKOMPETENS

for what the ecosystem often calls:

- Agent Skills
- skill packs
- prompt skills
- expert instructions
- procedure packs
- reference packs

A Specialkompetens is professional know-how.

It represents:

WHAT A PROFESSIONAL KNOWS
AND
HOW A PROFESSIONAL APPROACHES A PARTICULAR CLASS OF WORK.

It is NOT necessarily one SKILL.md file.

Possible atomic forms:

FULL_SKILL
REFERENCE_PACK
RULE_PACK
DETECTOR
PROCEDURE
DECISION_FRAMEWORK
EVALUATION_METHOD
KNOWLEDGE_FRAGMENT
CURATED_CORPUS
WORKFLOW_FRAGMENT

Do not equate:

GitHub repository
=
professional competency.

Allow useful fragments to be evaluated independently where licensing and
provenance permit it.

======================================================================
2. TERMINOLOGY: INSTRUMENTARIUM
======================================================================

Add a separate FIRST-CLASS concept:

INSTRUMENTARIUM

Specialkompetens answers:

"What does this worker know how to do?"

Instrumentarium answers:

"What professional instruments can this worker observe, measure, verify or
act through?"

An instrument may be exposed through:

- MCP
- CLI
- library
- API
- browser integration
- test runner
- analyzer
- compiler
- design application
- observability system
- data source
- custom Nortropic adapter

MCP is therefore NOT the architectural abstraction.

MCP is one possible INTERFACE to a professional instrument.

The architecture must select:

BEST VERIFIED INSTRUMENT
+
BEST VERIFIED INTERFACE

for a particular professional task.

PROFESSIONAL CAPABILITY

11. INSTRUMENTARIUM TAXONOMY
======================================================================

Develop the minimum useful taxonomy for professional tools.

Potential classes:

OBSERVATION

See what the system/browser actually does.

INTERACTION

Act like a real/synthetic user.

MEASUREMENT

Measure performance, accessibility, runtime behavior, etc.

VERIFICATION

Deterministically prove required properties.

DESIGN

Create/read structured design intent.

PRODUCTION OBSERVABILITY

Observe deployed/production behavior.

RESEARCH

Access authoritative or empirical information.

DELIVERY

Build/deploy/publish where authorized.

Do not over-formalize unless a classification has operational value.

14. MCP IS A TRUST BOUNDARY
======================================================================

Treat MCP as an authority-bearing integration surface.

For every MCP/tool candidate inspect:

PROVENANCE
VERSION
LICENSE
SERVER IDENTITY
TOOL DEFINITIONS
NETWORK ACCESS
FILESYSTEM ACCESS
SECRETS/CREDENTIALS
EXTERNAL DATA
WRITE EFFECTS
REMOTE MUTABILITY
PACKAGE INSTALLS
SUBPROCESSES
BROWSER SESSION ACCESS
AUTHENTICATED USER DATA
PROMPT-INJECTION EXPOSURE.

Distinguish:

READ / OBSERVE

from:

WRITE / MUTATE / DEPLOY / DELETE.

Default to least authority.

A browser-debugging tool should not automatically gain deployment authority.

A production-observability worker should not automatically gain project
mutation authority.

======================================================================
18. MARGINAL CONTRIBUTION
======================================================================

Do not evaluate:

"Is tool X useful?"

Evaluate:

"Does adding/replacing tool X improve Nortropic compared to the current
incumbent configuration?"

Measure where applicable:

- unique material defects found
- task completion
- hidden holdout improvement
- false positives
- false negatives
- root-cause quality
- regression detection
- recovery ability
- token/context use
- runtime latency
- monetary cost
- external dependencies
- operational reliability
- security/authority cost.

Possible result:

NEW MCP

quality benefit: negligible
tool calls: +80%
context: +25%
latency: +30%

→ REJECT.

A valid outcome is:

"New tool adds no meaningful professional value."

======================================================================
19. TOOL / SPECIALKOMPETENS ABLATION
======================================================================

More instruments and more skills may LOWER quality.

Periodically test removal.

Example current package:

A+B+C+D.

Run:

A+B+C
A+B+D
A+C+D
etc.

Identify:

REDUNDANT
CONTRADICTORY
STALE
CONTEXT-EXPENSIVE
SECURITY-EXPENSIVE
NO LONGER MARGINALLY USEFUL.

Optimize toward:

MINIMUM SUFFICIENT HIGH-PERFORMANCE PROFESSIONAL CONFIGURATION.

Nortropic should become cleaner as well as smarter.

======================================================================
20. CONFLICT RESOLUTION
======================================================================

Specialkompetenser and tools may conflict.

Examples:

Skill A recommends heavy expressive motion.

Skill B recommends restraint.

Tool A reports performance issue.

Tool B reports no issue.

Do not concatenate or average blindly.

Resolve based on:

- Site Quality Contract
- project capabilities
- source authority
- measurement quality
- environment
- reproducibility
- experiment
- production evidence.

Preserve unresolved disagreement as evidence.

======================================================================
21. MODEL × SPECIALKOMPETENS × INSTRUMENT
======================================================================

Integrate with Cross-Model Workforce Evolution.

A tool or skill may work differently with:

Claude
OpenAI
future model families.

Measure interactions.

Example:
```

## Meddelande 197 — ChatGPT (assistent)

Ja. Jag ser flera möjliga luckor nu — och några är viktigare än ytterligare skills eller MCP:er. Jag testar framför allt om vi har byggt en extremt stark **bygg- och förbättringsmaskin**, men fortfarande saknar delar av själva **professionen webbförvaltning över hela livscykeln**: verkliga användare, innehållsansvar, drift, juridik/risk, outcome-mätning och avveckling.

## Meddelande 198 — ChatGPT (assistent)

Den tydligaste kritiken från omvärldsgenomgången är faktiskt denna: **vi har byggt mycket starkare mekanismer för att lära från modeller, open source och syntetiska gymcase än för att lära från riktiga människor.** GOV.UK:s aktuella Service Standard är nästan brutalt tydlig här: user research ska fortsätta genom discovery, alpha, beta **och live**, kombineras med analytics, och QA får inte lämnas enbart åt automatiserade verktyg. 

Det betyder inte att Web Gym-idén är fel — tvärtom. Men **Gymmet får aldrig bli en simulerad verklighet som Nortropic börjar optimera mot istället för världen utanför.**
